name: Die Pizzerei
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Pizzeria in Innsbruck** – where authentic Italian flavors meet Tyrolean charm. Enjoy freshly baked **Pizza Napoletana**, crispy **Calzones**, and delicious **Pasta** in the heart of the city. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Diavola**, our wood-fired oven brings every dish to life.

Pair your meal with a cold **Radler** or a glass of local **Tyrolean wine** and soak in the cozy atmosphere. Just a short walk from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the **Inn River**, this is the perfect spot to relax after a day of exploring **Innsbruck** or the stunning **Tirol** landscapes.

**Come by for a taste of Italy in the Alps!**
